identity.name: Le Locle Automatic
identity.one_liner: The 2003 Tissot Le Locle — the 39.3mm dress watch with the ETA 2824-2 caliber, named after the Tissot home town in Switzerland. The most-cited Tissot dress watch.

narrative.story: The Le Locle is the 2003 Tissot dress watch named after the town where Tissot has been based since 1853. The 39.3mm stainless steel case, the 2824-2 automatic caliber, the 50m water resistance, and the sapphire crystal are the 2018 specification. The Le Locle is the most-cited Tissot dress watch and the watch a collector cites when they want a Swiss automatic dress watch at the under-$1,000 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The Le Locle line includes the T006.407 (date), T006.408 (day-date), T006.414 (chronograph), and T006.428 (small seconds). The 2824-2 caliber is the standard Swiss automatic workhorse.
